lines.poem: VEDUT' HO LA LUCENTE STELLA DIANA.

lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Toward me, a spirit from high heaven rode
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And chose my thought the place of his abode
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With such deep parlance of love’s verities
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That all Love’s powers did my sight accost
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As though I’d won unto his heart’s mid-most.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O Lady mine, doth not thy sight allege
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Him who hath set his hand upon my heart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When parched responses from my faint throat start
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And shudder for the terror of his edge?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He was Amor, who since he found you, dwells
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ever with me, and he was come from far;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: An archer is he as the Scythians are
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whose only joy is killing someone else.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My sobbing eyes are drawn upon his wrack,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And such harsh sighs upon my heart he casteth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I depart from that sad me he wasteth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With Death drawn close upon my wavering track,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Leading such tortures in his sombre train
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As, by all custom, wear out other men.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If I should pray this lady pitiless
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That Mercy to her heart be no more foeman,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: You’d call me clownish, vile, and say that no man
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Was so past hope and filled with vanities.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where find you now these novel cruelties?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For still you seem humility’s true leaven,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Wise and adorned, alert and subtle even,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And fashioned out in ways of gentleness.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My soul weeps through her sighs for grievous fear
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And all those sighs, which in the heart were found,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Deep drenched with tears do sobbing thence depart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then seems that on my mind there rains a clear
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Image of a lady, thoughtful, bound
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hither to keep death-watch upon that heart.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lady, my most rash eyes, the first who used
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To look upon thy face, the power-fraught,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Were, Lady, those by whom I was accused
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In that harsh place where Amor holdeth court.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And there before him was their proof adduced,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And judgment wrote me down: “Bondslave” to thee,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Though still I stay Grief’s prisoner, unloosed,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And Fear hath lien upon the heart of me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For the which charges, and without respite,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: They dragged me to a place where a sad horde
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of such as love and whom Love tortureth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Cried out, all pitying as I met their sight,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Now art thou servant unto such a Lord
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou’lt have none other one save only Death.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou fill’st my mind with griefs so populous
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That my soul irks him to be on the road.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Mine eyes cry out, “We cannot bear the load
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of sighs the grievous heart sends upon us.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love, sensitive to thy nobility,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Saith, “Sorrow is mine that thou must take thy death
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From this fair lady who will hear no breath
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In argument for aught save pitying thee.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I, as one beyond life’s compass thrown,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seem but a thing that’s fashioned to design,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Melted of bronze or carven in tree or stone.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A wound I bear within this heart of mine
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which by its mastering quality is grown
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To be of that heart’s death an open sign.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who is she coming, drawing all men’s gaze,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who makes the air one trembling clarity
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till none can speak but each sighs piteously
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where she leads Love adown her trodden ways?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ah God! The thing she’s like when her glance strays,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Let Amor tell. ’Tis no fit speech for me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Mistress she seems of such great modesty
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That every other woman were called “Wrath.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: No one could ever tell the charm she hath
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For all the noble powers bend toward her,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She being beauty’s godhead manifest.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Our daring ne’er before held such high quest;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But ye! There is not in you so much grace
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That we can understand her rightfully.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ah why! why were mine eyes not quenched for me,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Or stricken so that from their vision none
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Had ever come within my mind to say:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Listen, dost thou not hear me in thine heart?”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Fear of new torments was then so displayed
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To me, so cruel and so sharp of edge
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That my soul cried, “Ah mistress, bring us aid,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lest th’eyes and I remain in grief always.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But thou hast left them so that Amor cometh
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And weepeth over them so piteously
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That there’s a deep voice heard whose sound in part
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Turned unto words, is this: “Whoever knoweth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Pain’s depth, let him look on this man whose heart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Death beareth in his hand cut cruciform.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: At last I am reduced to self compassion,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For the sore anguish that I see me in;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: At my great weakness; that my soul hath been
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Concealed beneath her wounds in such a fashion:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Such mine oppression that I know, in brief,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That to my life ill’s worst starred ills befall;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And this strange lady on whose grace I call
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Maintains continuous my stour of grief,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For when I look in her direction,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She turns upon me her disdeigning eyen
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So harshly that my waiting heart is rent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And all my powers and properties are spent,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till that heart lieth for a sign ill-seen,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where Amor’s cruelty hath hurled him down.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Alas, my spirits, that ye come to find me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So painful, poor, waylaid in wretchedness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet send no words adorned with deep distress
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Forth from my mind to say what sorrows bind me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Alas, ye see how sore my heart is wounded
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By glance, by fair delight and by her meekness;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: ‘Las! Must I pray ye that ye aid his weakness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing him power-stripped, naked, confounded.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And now a spirit that is noble and haut
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Appeareth to that heart with so great might
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That all th’ heart’s virtues turn in sudden flight.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Woe! And I pray you greet my soul as friend,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who tells through all her grief what things were wrought
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: On her by Love, and will be to the end.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If Mercy were the friend of my desires,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Or Mercy’s source of movement were the heart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then, by this fair, would Mercy show such art
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And power of healing as my pain requires.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From torturing delights my sighs commence,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Born of the mind where Love is situate,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Go errant forth and naught save grief relate
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And find no one to give them audience.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: They would return to the eyes in galliard mode,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With all harsh tears and their deep bitterness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Transmuted into revelry and joy;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Were’t not unto the sad heart such annoy,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And to the mournful soul such rathe distress
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That none doth deign salute them on the road.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The grace of youth in Toulouse ventureth;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She’s noble and fair, with quaint sincerities,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Direct she is and is about her eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Most like to our Lady of sweet memories.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So that within my heart desirous
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She hath clad the soul in fashions peregrine.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Pilgrim to her he hath too great chagrin
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To say what Lady is lord over us.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This soul looks deep into that look of hers,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Wherein he rouseth Love to festival,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For deep therein his rightful lady resteth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then with sad sighing in the heart he stirs,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Feeling his death-wound as that dart doth fall
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which this Tolosan by departure casteth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Subtle the spirit striking through the eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which rouseth up a spirit in the mind
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whence moves a spirit unto love inclined
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which breeds, in other sprites, nobilities.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: No turbid spirit hath the sense which sees
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: How greatly empowered a spirit he appeareth;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He is the little breath which that breath feareth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which breedeth virginal humilities.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet from this spirit doth another move
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Wherein such tempered sweetness rightly dwells
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That Mercy’s spirit followeth his ways,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And Mercy’s spirit as it moves above
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Rains down those spirits that ope all things else,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Perforce of One who seeth all of these.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Surely thine intellect gives no embrace
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To him who hath bred this day’s dishonesty;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: How art thou shown for beggared suddenly
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By that red spirit showing in thy face!
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Perhaps it is some love within thee breedeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For her who’s folly’s circumscription,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Perhaps some baser light doth call thee on
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To make thee glad where mine own grief exceedeth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou art my grief, my grief to such extent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I trust not myself to meet Milady,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Starving myself of what Love sweetest lent me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So that before my face that key’s forbent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which her disdeign turned in my heart and made me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Suitor to wrath and sadness and lamenting.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou hast in thee the flower and the green
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And that which gleameth and is fair of sight,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thy form is more resplendent than sun’s sheen;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who sees thee not, can ne’er know worth aright.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nay, in this world there is no creature seen
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So fashioned fair and full of all delight;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who fears Amor, and fearing meets thy mien,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thereby assured, he solveth him his fright.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The ladies of whom thy cortege consisteth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Please me in this, that they’ve thy favour won;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I bid them now, as courtesy existeth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Holding most dear thy lordship of their state,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To honour thee with powers commensurate,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sith thou art thou, that art sans paragon.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This most lief lady, where doth Love display him
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So full of valour and so vestured bright,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Bids thy heart “Out!” He goes and none gainsay him;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And he takes life with her in long delight.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Her cloister’s guard is such that should you journey
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To Ind you’d see each unicorn obey it;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Its armed might against thee in sweet tourney
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Cruel riposteth, thou canst not withstay it.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And she is surely in her valliancies
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Such that she lacks not now worth’s anything,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And yet He made her for a mortal creature.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then showed her forth, and here His foresight is,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And His providence, Ah, how fair a thing
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If by her likeness thou mayst learn its nature!
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Now every cool small spring that springeth sweetly
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Takes clarity and virtue in Liscian climes,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Bernard my friend, from one sole source, discretely:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So she who answereth thy sharpened rimes.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For in that place where Love’s reports are laid
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Concerning all who to his sight are led,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He saith that this so gracious and fair maid
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hath in herself all graces gathered.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whereas my grief in this is grown more grave
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And sighs have turned me to one light and flame,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I send my burning heart, in her acclaim
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Unto Pinella, upon a magic stream
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where fairies and their fair attendants gleam,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In this wrecked barque! where their show is so brave!
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Beauty of woman, of the knowing heart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And courtly knights in bright accoutrement
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And loving speeches and the small birds’ art,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Adorned swift ships which on high seas are sent,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And airs grown calm when white the dawn appeareth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And white snow falling where no wind is bent,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Brook-marge and mead where every flower flareth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And gold and silver and azure and ornament:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Effective ‘gainst all these think ye the fairness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And valour of my Lady’s lordly daring?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yea, she makes all seem base vain gathering,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And she were known above whome’er you’d bring
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As much as heaven is past earth’s comparing;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Good seeketh out its like with some address.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He suggests to his kinsman Nerone that there
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: may be one among all the Buondelmonti of whom
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: they might in time make a man
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: News have I now for thee, so hear, Nerone,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: How that the Buondelmonti shake with fear,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And all the Florentines cannot assure them,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing thou hast in thee the lion-heart.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: They fear thee more than they would fear a dragon,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing that face of thine, how set it is
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That neither bridge nor walls could hold against it
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lest they were strong as is King Pharaoh’s tomb.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Oh how thou dost of smoky sins the greatest
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In that thou wouldst drive forth such haughty blood
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till all be gone, gone forth without retention.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But sooth it is, thou might’st extend the pawn
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of one whose soul thou mightest give salvation
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Wert thou more patient in thine huckstering.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So vilely is this soul of mine confounded
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By strife grown audible within the heart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That if toward her some frail Love but start
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With unaccustomed speed, she swoons astounded.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She is as one in whom no power aboundeth;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lo, she forsakes my heart through fearfulness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And any seeing her, how prone she is,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Would deem her one whom death’s sure cloak surroundeth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Through th’ eyes, as through the breach in wall, her foes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Came first to attack and shattered all defence,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then spoiled the mind with their down-rained blows.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whoe’er he be who holdeth joy most close
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Would, should he see my spirit going hence,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Weep for the pity and make no pretence.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou mayest see, who seest me face to face,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That most dred spirit whom Love summoneth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To meet with man when a man meets with Death;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: One never seen in any other case.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So close upon me did this presence show
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I thought he would slay my heart his dolour,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And my sad soul clad her in the dead colour
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That most accords the will and ways of woe.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then he restrained him, seeing in true faith
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The piteous lights forth-issue from your eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The which bore to my heart their foreign sweetness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: While the perceptive sense with subtle fleetness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Rescued those others* who had considered death
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The one sure ending for their miseries.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou sawest, it seems to me, all things availing,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And every joy that ever good man feeleth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou wast in proof of that lord valorous
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who through sheer honour lords it o’er the world.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou livest in a place where baseness dieth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And holdest reason in the piteous mind:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So gently move the people in this sleep
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That the heart bears it ‘thout the feel of grief.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love bore away thy heart, because in his sight
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Was Death grown clamorous for one thou lovest,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love fed her with thy heart in dread of this,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then, when it seemed to thee he left in sadness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A dear dream was it which was there completed
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing it contrary came conquering.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I daily come to thee uncounting times
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And find thee ever thinking over vilely;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Much doth it grieve me that thy noble mind
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And virtue’s plenitude are stripped from thee;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou wast so careless in thy fine offending,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who from the rabble alway held apart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And spoke of me so straightly from the heart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I gave welcome to thine every rime.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And now I care not, sith thy life is baseness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To give the sign that thy speech pleaseth me,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nor come I to thee in guise visible,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet if thou’It read this sonnet many a time,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That malign spirit which so hunteth thee
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Will sound forloyn and spare thy affrighted soul.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Dante, I pray thee, if thou Love discover
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In any place where Lappo Gianni is, —
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If’t irk thee not to move thy mind in this,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Write me these answered: “Doth he style him Lover?”;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And, “Doth the lady seem as one approving?”;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And, “Makes he show of service with fair skill?”;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For many a time folk made as he is, will
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To assume importance, make a show of loving.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou know’st that in that court where Love puts on
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: His royal robes, no vile man can be servant
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To any lady who were lost therein;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If servant’s suff’ring doth assistance win,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Our style could show unto the least observant,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: It beareth mercy for a gonfalon.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Come, come Manetto, look upon this scarecrow
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And set your mind upon its deformations,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Compute th’ extent of its sad aberrations,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Say what it looks like where she scarcely dare go!
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nay, were she in a cloak most well concealed
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And snugly hooded and most tightly veiled
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If, by her, daylight should once be assailed
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Though by some noble woman partly healed,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Still you could not be so sin-laden or quite
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So bound by anguish or by love’s abstractions
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nor so enwrapped in naked melancholy
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But you were brought to deathly danger, solely
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By laughter, till your sturdy sides grew fractions,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: ‘Struth you were dead, or sought your life in flight.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nay, when I would have sent my verses to thee
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To say how harshly my heart is oppressed,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love in an ashen vision manifest
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Appeared and spake: “Say not that I foredo thee,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For though thy friend be he I understand
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He will not yet have his mind so enured
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But that to hear of all thou hast endured,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of that blare flame that hath thee ‘neath its hand,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Would blear his mind out. Verily before!
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yea, he were dead, heart, life, ere he should hear
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To the last meaning of the portent wrought.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And thou; thou knowest well I am Amor
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who leave with thee mine ashen likeness here
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And bear away from thee thine every thought.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Were I that I that once was worthy of Love
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: (Of whom I find naught now save the remembrance)
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And if the lady had another semblance,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then would this sort of sign please me enough.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Do thou, who art from Love’s clear realm returned,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where Mercy giveth birth to hopefulness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Judge as thou canst from my dim mood’s distress
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: What bowman and what target are concerned.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Straining his arc, behold Amor the bowman
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Draweth so gaily that to see his face
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: You’d say he held his rule for merriment,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet hear what’s marvelous in all intent:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The smitten spirit pardoneth his foeman
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which pardon doth that foeman’s power debase.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A love-lit glance, with living powers fraught,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Renewed within me love’s extreme delight,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So love assails me with unwonted might,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And cordially he driveth me in thought
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Towards my lady with whom ‘vaileth not
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Mercy nor pity nor the suffering wrought.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So oft and great, her torments on me fall
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That my heart scarce can feel his life at all.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But when I feel that her so sweet regard
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Passeth mine eyes and to the heart attaineth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Setting to rest therein spirits of joy,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then do I give her thanks and without retard;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love asked her to do this, and that explaineth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Why this first pity doth no annoy.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Dante, a sigh, that’s the heart’s messenger
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Assailed me suddenly as I lay sleeping;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Aroused, I fell straightway into fear’s keeping,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For Love came with that sigh as curator.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I turned straight and saw the servitor
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of Monna Lagia, who came there a-crying,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Ah pity! Aid me!” and at this his sighing
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I took from Pity this much power and more:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I found Love a-filing javelins
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And asked him of both torment and solution,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And in this fashion came that Lord’s replies:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Say to the servant that his service wins.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He holds the Lady to his pleasure won.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If he’d believe it, let him watch her eyes.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I fear me lest unfortune’s counter thrust
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Pierce through my throat and rip out my despair.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I feel my heart and that thought shaking there
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which shakes the aspen mind with his distrust,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeming to say, “Love doth not give thee ease
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So that thou canst, as of a little thing,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Speak to thy Lady with full verities,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For fear Death set thee in his reckoning.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By the chagrin that here assails my soul
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My heart’s parturéd of a sigh so great
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: It cryeth to the spirits: “Get ye gone!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And of all piteous folk I come on none
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who seeing me so in my grief’s control
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Will aid by saying e’en: “Nay, Spirits, wait!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: You, who within your eyes so often carry
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That Love who holdeth in his hand three arrows,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Behold my spirit, by his far-brought sorrows,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Commends to you a soul whom hot griefs harry.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A mind thrice wounded she* already hath,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: By this keen archer’s Syrian shafts twice shot.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The third, less tautly drawn, hath reached me not,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing your presence is my shield ‘gainst wrath.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet this third shot had made more safe my soul,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who almost dead beneath her members lies;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For these two arrows give three wounds in all:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The first: delight, which payeth pain his toll;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The second brings desire for the prize
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of that great joy which with the third doth fall.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If Santalena does not come unto you
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Down in the plow-lands where the clods are hard,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But falls into the hands of some hot clod-pole
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who’ll wear her out and hardly then return her;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then tell me if the fruit which this land beareth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Is born of drought or heat or from the dampness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And say what wind it is doth blight and wither
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And which doth bring the tempest and the mist.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Say if it please you when at break of morning
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: You hear the farmer’s workman bawling out
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And all his family meddling in the noise?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Egad! I think that if your sweet Bettina
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Beareth a mellow spirit in her heart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She’ll rescue you once more from your last choice.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Death who art haught, the wretched’s remedy,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Grace! Grace! hands joined I do beseech it thee,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Come, see and conquer for worse things on me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Are launched by love. My senses that did live,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Consumed are and quenched, and e’en in this place
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where I was galliard, now I see that I am
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Fallen away, and where my steps I misplace,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Fall pain and grief; to open tears I nigh am.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And greater ills He’d send if greater may be.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sweet Death, now is the time thou may’st avail me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And snatch me from His hand’s hostility.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ah woe! how oft I cry “Love tell me now:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Why dost thou ill only unto thine own,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Like him of hell who maketh the damned groan?”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Amore and Mona Lagia and Guido and I
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Can give true thanks unto Ser Such-a-one
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who hath now ridded us of Know-you-who?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I’ll name no name for I’d have it forgotten.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And these three people have no wish for it
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Though they were servants to him in such wise
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That they, in sooth, could not have served him more
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Had they mistaken him for God himself.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Let Love be thanked who was first made aware,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And then give thanks unto the prudent lady
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who at Love’s instance hath called back her heart;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then thanks to Guido* who’s not here concerned
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And to me too who drove him back to virtue,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If then he please me, think it not perchance.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: He explains the miracles of the Madonna of Or San
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Michele, by telling whose image it is
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My Lady’s face it is they worship there,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: At San Michele in Orto, Guido mine,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Near her fair semblance that is clear and holy,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sinners take refuge and get consolation.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whoso before her kneeleth reverently
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: No longer wasteth but is comforted;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The sick are healed and devils driven forth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And those with crooked eyes see straightway straight.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Great ills she cureth in an open place,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With reverence the folk all kneel unto her,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And two lamps shed the glow about her form.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Her voice is borne out through far-lying ways
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: ‘Till brothers minor cry: “Idolatry,”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For envy of her precious neighborhood.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O world gone blind and full of false deceits,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Deadly’s the poison with thy joys connected,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O treacherous thou, and guileful and suspected:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sure he is mad who for thy checks retreats
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And for scant nothing loseth that green prize
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which over-gleams all other loveliness;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Wherefore the wise man scorns thee at all hours
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When he would taste the fruit of pleasant flowers.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sith need hath bound my heart in bands of grief,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sith I turn flame in pleasure’s saffron fire,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I sing how I lost a treasure by desire
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And left all virtue and am low descended.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I tell, with senses dead, what scant relief
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My heart from war hath in his life’s small might.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Nay! were not death turned pleasure in my sight
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then Love would weep to see me so offended.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet, for I’m come upon a madder season,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The firm opinion which I held of late
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Stands in a changed state,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I show not how much my soul is grieved
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: There where I am deceived
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Since through my heart midway a mistress went
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And in her passage all mine hopes were spent.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ladies I saw a-passing where she passed;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Not that they seemed as ladies to my vision,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who were like nothing save her shadow cast.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I praise her in no cause save verity’s
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: None other dispraise, if ye comprehend me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A spirit moveth speaking prophecies
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Foretelling: Spirits mine, swift death shall end ye,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Cruel! if seeing me no tears forelend ye,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sith but the being in thought sets wide mine eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For sobbing out my heart’s full memories.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Tho’ all thy piteous mercy fall away
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Not for thy failing shall my faith so fall,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That Faith speaks on of services unpaid
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To the unpitied heart.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: What that heart feeleth? Ye believe me not.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who sees such things? Surely no one at all,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For Love me gives a spirit on his part
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who dieth if portrayed.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thence when that pleasure so assaileth me,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And the sighing faileth me,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Within my heart a rain of love descendeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So fragrantly, so purely
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I cry out, “Lady, thou hold’st me surely!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Weeping ye see me, in Grief’s company,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: One showing forth Love’s jurisdiction.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of pity-shrouded hearts I find not one
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who sigheth, seeing me disconsolate.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: New is the grief that’s come upon my heart,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And mournful is the press of my deep sighs,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And oft Death greeteth me, by tricksome art
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Drawn close upon me with his agonies,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yea close, drawn close till every dullard sees;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I hear their murmuring, “How grief hath bent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This man! And we from the apparent testament,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Deem stranger torments in him sublimate.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Within my heart this grievous weight descended
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hath slain that band of spirits which was bent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Heartward, that th’ heart might by them be defended.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When the sad heart had summoned them they’d left
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Mine eyes of every other guard bereft
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till Rumour, courier through the mind, ran crying
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A vileness in the heart, Oyez! lies dying
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: On guard lest vileness strike at your estate!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Light do I see within my Lady’s eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And loving spirits in its plenisphere
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which bear in strange delight on my heart’s care
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: fill Joy s awakened from that sepulchre.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That which befalls me in my Lady’s presence
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Bars explanations intellectual,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I seem to see a lady wonderfiil
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Forth issue from Her lips, one whom no sense
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Can fully tell the mind of and one whence
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Another fair, swift born, moves marvelous,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From whom a star goes forth and speaketh thus:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lo, thy salvation is gone forth from thee.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: There where this Lady’s loveliness appeareth,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I here s heard a voice which goes before her ways
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And seems to sing her name with such sweet praise
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That my mouth fears to speak what name she beareth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: my heart trembles for the grace she weareth,’
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: While far in my soul’s deep the sighs astir
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Speak thus: “Look well! For if thou look on her,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then shaft thou see her virtue risen in heaven.”’
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Vid. Introduction.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The harshness of my strange and new misventure
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hath in my mind distraught
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The wonted fragrance of love’s every thought.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Already is my life in such part shaken
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That she, my gracious lady of delight,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hath left my soul most desolate forsaken
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And e’en the place she was, is gone from sight;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And there rests not within me so much might
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That my mind can reach forth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To comprehend the flower of her worth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This noble thought is come well winged with death,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Namely, that I shall ne’er see her again,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And this harsh torment, with no pity fraught,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Increaseth bitterness and in its strain
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I cry, and find none to attend my pain,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: While for the flame I feel,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I thank that lord who turns grief’s fortune wheel.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Full of all anguish and within Fear’s gates
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The spirit of my heart lies sorrowfully,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thanks to that Fortune who my fortune hates,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who’th spun death’s lot where it most irketh me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And given hope that’s ta’en in treachery,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
