lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which ere it died aright
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Had robbed me of mine hours of delight.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O words of mine foredone and full of terror,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Whither it please ye, go forth and proclaim
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Grief. Throughout all your wayfare, in your error
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Make ye soft clamour of my Lady’s name,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: While I downcast and fallen upon shame
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Keep scant shields over me,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To whomso runs, death’s colours cover me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Being in thought of love I came upon
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Two damsels strange
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who sang, “The joyous rains
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of love descend within us.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So quiet in their modest courtesies
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Their aspect coming softly on my vision
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Made me reply, “Surely ye hold the keys
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O the virtues noble, high, without omission.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ah, little maids, hold me not in derision,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For the wound I bear within me
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And this heart o’ mine ha’ slain me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I was in Toulouse lately.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And then toward me they so turned their eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That they could see my wounded heart’s ill ease,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And how a little spirit born of sighs
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Had issued forth from out the cicatrice.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Perceiving so the depth of my distress,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She who was smiling, said,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: ‘Love’s joy hath vanquished
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This man. Behold how greatly!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then she who had first mocked me, in better part
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Gave me all courtesy in her replies.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She said, That Lady, who upon thine heart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Cut her full image, clear, by Love’s device,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hath looked so fixedly in through thine eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That she’s made Love appear there;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If thou great pain or fear bear
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Recommend thee unto him!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then the other piteous, full of misericorde,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Fashioned for pleasure in love’s fashioning:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “His heart s apparent wound, I give my word,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Was gat from eyes whose power’s an o’er great thing
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Which eyes have left in his a glittering
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That mine can not endure.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Tell me, hast thou a sure
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Memory of those eyes?”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To her dred question with such fears attended,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Maid o’ the wood,” I said, “my memories render
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Tolosa and the dusk and these things blended:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A lady in a corded bodice, slender
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: — Mandetta is the name Love’s spirits lend her —
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A lightning swift to fall,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And naught within recall
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Save, Death! My wounds! Her eyes!”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: (Envoi)
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Speed Ballatet’ unto Tolosa city
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And go in softly neath the golden roof
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And there cry out, “Will courtesy or pity
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of any most fair lady, put to proof,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lead me to her with whom is my behoof?”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Then if thou get her choice
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Say, with a lowered voice,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “It is thy grace I seek here.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The eyes of this gentle maid of the forest
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Have set my mind in such bewilderment
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That all my wistful thoughts on her are bent.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So doth she pierce me when mine eyes regard her
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I hear sighs a-trembling in mine heart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As from her eyes aye sources of mine ardour
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: The quaint small spirits of Amor forth-dart
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From which small sprites such greater powers start
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That when they reach me my faint soul is sent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Exhausted forth to swoon in banishment.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I feel how from my eyes the sighs forth-fare
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When my mind reasoneth with me of her,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till I see torments raining through the air.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Draggled by griefs, which I by these incur,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Mine every strength turns mine abandoner,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I know not what place I am toward,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Save that Death hath me in his castle-yard.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I am so outworn that now for mercy
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I am not bold to cry out even in thought,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I find Love, who speaking saith of her, “See,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She is not one whose image could be wrought.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Unto her presence no man could be brought
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who did not well to tremble for the daring.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And I? Would swoon if I should meet her faring.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: (Envoi)
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Go! Ballad mine, and when thy journey has won
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Unto my Lady’s presence wonderful,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Speak of my anguish in some fitting fashion,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Sorrowfully thus, “My sender is sorrowful,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lo, how he saith, he hath no hope at all
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Of drawing pity from such Courtesy
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As keeps his Lady’s gracious company.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: In wood-way found I once a shepherdess,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: More fair than stars are was she to my seeming.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Her hair was wavy somewhat, like dull gold.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Eyes? Love-worn, and her face like some pale rose.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With a small twig she kept her lambs in hold,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And bare her feet were bar the dew-drop’s gloze;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She sang as one whom mad love holdeth close,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And joy was on her for an ornament.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I greeted her in love without delaying:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Hast thou companion in thy solitude?”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And she replied to me most sweetly, saying,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Nay, I am quite alone in all this wood,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: But when the birds ‘gin singing in their coverts
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My heart is fain that time to find a lover.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As she was speaking thus of her condition
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I heard the bird-song ‘neath the forest shade
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And thought me how’t was but the time’s provision
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To gather joy of this small shepherd maid.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Favour I asked her, but for kisses only,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And then I felt her pleasant arms upon me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She held to me with a dear willfulness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Saying her heart had gone into my bosom,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: She drew me on to a cool leafy place
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Where I gat sight of every coloured blossom,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And there I drank in so much summer sweetness
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Meseemed Love’s god connived at its completeness.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Now can I tell you tidings of mine eyes,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: News which such pleasure to my heart supplyeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That Love himself for glory of it sigheth.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This new delight which my heart drinketh in
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Was drawn from nothing save a woman seen
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Who hath such charm and a so courtly mien
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And such fair fashion that the heart is fain
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: To greet her beauty, which nor base nor mean
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Can know, because its hue and qualities demand
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Intelligence in him who would understand.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I see Love grow resplendent in her eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: With such great power and such noble thought
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: As hold therein all gracious ecstacies,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From them there moves a soul so subt’y wrought
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That all compared thereto are set at naught
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And judgment of her speaks no truth save this:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: A splendour strange and unforeseen she is.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: (Envoi)
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Go Ballatetta, forth and find my Lady
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ask if she have it this much of mercy ready
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This namely, that she turn her eyes toward thee Ask in his name whose whole faith rests in her.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And if she gracious, this much grace accord thee,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Offer glad voiced incense of sweet savour
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Proclaming of whom thou receiv’st such favour.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Because no hope is left me, Ballatetta,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Or return to Tuscany,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Light-foot go thou some fleet way
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Unto my Lady straightway,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And out of her courtesy
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Great honour will she do thee.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Tidings thou bearest with thee sorrow-fain
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Full of all grieving, overcast with fear.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: On guard! Lest any one see thee or hear
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Any who holds high nature in disdeign
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: For sure if so, to my increase of pain,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou wert made prisoner
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And held afar from her,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Hereby new harms were given
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Me, and after death even
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Dolour and griefs renewed.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou knowest, Ballatetta, that Death layeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: His hand upon me whom hath Life forsaken:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Thou knowest well how great a tumult swayeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: My heart at sound of her whom each sense cryeth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till all my mournful body is so shaken
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That I can not endure here,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Would’st thou make service sure here?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Lead forth my soul with thee
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: (I pray thee earnestly)
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When it parts from my heart here.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Ah, Ballatetta, to thy friendliness,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: I do give o’er this trembling soul’s poor case.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Bring thou it there where her dear pity is,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And when thou hast found that Lady of all grace
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Speak through thy sighs, my Ballad, with thy face
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Low bowed, thy words in sum:
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: “Behold, thy servant is come,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: This soul who would dwell with thee,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Assundered suddenly
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: From Him, Love’s servitor.”
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: O smothered voice and weak that tak’st the road
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Out from the weeping heart and dolorous
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Go crying out my most sad mind’s alarm
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Forth with my soul and this song piteous
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Until thou find a lady of such charm,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So sweetly intelligent
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That e’en thy sorrow is rent.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Take thy fast place before her.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And thou, Soul mine, adore her
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Alway, with all thy might.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: If all my life be but some deathly moving,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Joy dragged from heaviness;
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Seeing my deep distress
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: How doth Love’s spirit call me unto loving?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: How summon up my heart for dalliance?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: When’t is so sorrowful
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And manacled by sighs so mournfully
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That e’en the will for grace dare not advance?
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Weariness over all
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Spoileth that heart of power, despoiling me.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And song, sweet laughter and benignity
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Are grown three grievous sighs,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Till all men’s careless eyes
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: May see Death risen to my countenance.
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Love that is born of loving like delight,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Within my heart sojourneth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: And fashions a new person from desire
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: Yet toppleth down to vileness all his might,
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: So all Love’s daring spurneth
lines.author: Ezra Pound
lines.work: THE SONNETS AND BALLATE OF GUIDO CAVALCANTI

lines.text: That man who knoweth service and its hire.
